name: Browserbase MCP Server
summary: Hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server giving any MCP client a cloud browser on Browserbase, driven by natural language via Stagehand.
description: The hosted endpoint is recommended; a local STDIO mode also exists. The original open-source repo browserbase/mcp-server-browserbase is archived as a historical reference implementation.

agent_access.notes: Pass the key as ?browserbaseApiKey=... on the endpoint URL.
